item.title: Unbreakable X-Men #3 Preview: Gambit Gets Wet and Wild
item.description: Unbreakable X-Men #3 hits stores Wednesday. Gambit faces Namor and cosmic threats in an underwater showdown. Death is definitely permanent here.

item.title: Tainted Grail Reveals Its First Expansion "Sanctuary of Sarras"
item.description: Open-world RPG Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon has revealed its first expansion, Sanctuary of Sarras, set to be released next week

item.title: I Hate Fairyland #46 Preview: Gertrude's Misguided Monster Mash
item.description: I Hate Fairyland #46 unleashes Gertrudenstein's Monster this Wednesday. Will Fairyland survive its latest horrific creation? Probably not.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino Teases Kill Bill Prequel About Bill's Origin
item.description: Quentin Tarantino reveals he wants to make a Kill Bill prequel focused on Bill’s origin, just as The Whole Bloody Affair hits theaters.

item.title: Supergirl: The First Teaser Trailer Will Be Released This Week
item.description: James Gunn has revealed that the first teaser trailer for Supergirl is dropping sometime this week.

item.title: The Finals Launches Season 9: Dragon Rising This Week
item.description: The Finals has a new deadly season coming this week, as the team revealed more details about what's happening in Season 9: Dragon Rising

item.title: First Draft Of Spider-Punk Film Script Is In The "Finishing Stages"
item.description: Daniel Kaluuya has revealed that the first draft for the Spider-Punk animated spin-off film is in its "finishing stages," but isn't sharing any other details.

item.title: Amazing Spider-Man #17 Preview: Spidey's Galactic Getaway
item.description: Peter Parker's lost in space in Amazing Spider-Man #17, but after losing to Hellgate, does he even want to come home? Previewing Wednesday's issue!
